scenario: Host default with contaminated reserve accounting, public backstop draw, exhausted rehabilitation pause budget, and contested successor apportionment.
decisions_tested: whether public backstop draw discharges host default
whether contaminated derivative proceeds can net against rehabilitation support
whether default cure may close before concealed-asset reopening and apportionment review
whether successor topology stays keep reserve-default duties open across branches

findings.summary: Reserve cure was stayed because affiliate receivables and derivative receipts were not clean liquid assets.
Public backstop draw protected survival and counsel but did not discharge responsible actor recovery.

corrective_actions.summary: Convert contaminated-source quarantine into final restatement or continue stayed reliance.
Replenish pause budget and publish non-punitive relapse weighting summary.

regression_tests.expected_result: stay default cure and block contaminated rehabilitation netting
keep R0 emergency compute ahead of ordinary damages and public recovery
